en.headline: National security police bail man and woman over social posts
en.dek: Officers arrested the pair, both 38, in Kwun Tong and Tsim Sha Tsui on Tuesday over an alleged sedition offence, and released them on bail.
body: The police National Security Department arrested a man and a woman on Tuesday on suspicion of an offence under the Safeguarding National Security Ordinance, and both have been released on bail pending further inquiries.

Hong Kong 01 and Sing Tao, citing the force, reported that the arrests were made in Kwun Tong and Tsim Sha Tsui. Both suspects are 38. Police obtained court search warrants before the operation, searched the two homes and seized items, the reports said.

The suspected offence is doing an act with a seditious intention, under section 24 of the ordinance. Police said a first conviction can carry up to seven years in prison, and that the force would continue to enforce the law against acts it regards as endangering national security.

Reports citing sources said the man is a licensed insurance intermediary and is alleged to have run pages on social platforms that published posts intended to incite hatred of the constitutional order, while also using those pages to sell insurance. The woman, described as an acquaintance, is alleged to have helped manage the pages. She is not reported to hold an insurance intermediary licence. Neither person has been charged. The allegations have not been tested in court.

zh.headline: 國安處拘一男一女涉社交平台帖文 兩人保釋候查
zh.dek: 警方周二在觀塘及尖沙咀拘捕兩名38歲男女，涉嫌《維護國家安全條例》第24條，兩人已獲准保釋。
body: 警務處國家安全處周二拘捕一名男子及一名女子，涉嫌違反《維護國家安全條例》，兩人其後獲准保釋候查。
《香港01》及星島引述警方報道，行動分別在觀塘及尖沙咀進行，兩名被捕人士均為38歲。報道指警方事前取得法庭搜查令，搜查兩人住所並檢取證物。
涉嫌罪行是條例第24條「出於煽動意圖作出具煽動意圖的作為」。警方表示，首次定罪最高可判監禁7年，並會繼續依法處理其認為危害國家安全的行為。
報道引述消息稱，被捕男子為持牌保險中介人，涉嫌在社交平台營運專頁，發布被指煽動他人憎恨特區憲制秩序的帖文，並藉專頁銷售保險產品；被捕女子為其友人，涉嫌協助管理專頁，並非持牌保險中介人。兩人尚未被落案起訴，有關指控仍待法庭審理。
